steps.tx: **Papillary thyroid carcinoma** PTC is the most common endocrine malignancy, characterized cytologically by ground-glass Orphan Annie nuclei, nuclear pseudoinclusions, and psammoma bodies. PTC accounts for eighty-five percent of differentiated thyroid neoplasms. Fine-needle aspiration cytology classified under the Bethesda system guides surgical planning, with lobectomy or total thyroidectomy providing high long-term cure rates.

right.title: Follicular Thyroid Carcinoma (FTC)
points: Capsular or vascular invasion required for diagnosis

steps.tx: This cytology captures **papillary carcinoma**, the commonest endocrine malignancy, through its nuclear hallmarks. Pale **ground glass nuclei** show sharp longitudinal **nuclear grooves** plus one round **pseudoinclusion**, beside a laminated psammoma body. Together these features let aspiration cytology confirm the diagnosis and plan curative surgery.
steps.say: Papillary thyroid cancer has a distinctive look under the microscope with empty appearing Orphan Annie nuclei, central grooves, and occasional round inclusions inside nuclei. Calcified layered psammoma bodies add support. This field gathers all those clues in one view. Finding them on needle sampling secures the diagnosis and guides whether limited or total thyroid removal offers cure.

vis.alt: Thyroid cytology shows grooved ground glass nuclei with a pseudoinclusion beside a psammoma body.
vis.caption: Thyroid cytology displays classic papillary nuclear features. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Molecular alterations influence biological aggression and sodium-iodide symporter expression. **BRAF V600E** point mutations occur in approximately 60% of papillary thyroid carcinomas, associated with aggressive clinicopathological features and loss of radioiodine avidity. Constitutive MAPK pathway activation downregulates thyroid iodide-handling genes, predisposing tumours to extrathyroidal extension, nodal metastases, and radioiodine refractoriness.

steps.tx: Potent anti-angiogenic kinase inhibitors yield substantial disease control in progressive disease. **Lenvatinib** multi-targeted TKI significantly improves progression-free survival and objective response rate in radioactive iodine-refractory differentiated thyroid cancer in the SELECT trial. Median progression-free survival reached 18.3 months with lenvatinib versus 3.6 months with placebo, accompanied by an impressive sixty-five percent response rate.

left.title: Lenvatinib (SELECT Trial)
points: Primary first-line choice for RAI-refractory DTC

steps.tx: Alternative multikinase inhibitors provide validated secondary or first-line treatment choices. **Sorafenib** multi-kinase inhibitor prolongs progression-free survival in radioactive iodine-refractory advanced differentiated thyroid carcinoma based on the randomized DECISION trial. Sorafenib inhibits VEGFR, PDGFR, and CRAF/BRAF kinases, improving median progression-free survival to 10.8 months compared to 5.8 months with placebo.

rows: Preferred first-line for progressive RAI-refractory DTC
First approved TKI for RAI-refractory DTC

steps.tx: Parafollicular C-cell neoplasms produce neuroendocrine markers rather than thyroglobulin. **Medullary thyroid carcinoma** MTC arises from calcitonin-secreting parafollicular C cells, strongly driven by germline or somatic activating RET proto-oncogene mutations. In MEN 2A and 2B, germline mutations in extracellular cysteine or intracellular kinase domains trigger ligand-independent RET dimerization, dictating age-specific prophylactic thyroidectomy in infancy or early childhood.

steps.tx: Next-generation selective kinase inhibitors surpass non-selective anti-angiogenic multikinase drugs. Highly selective RET inhibitors **selpercatinib** and pralsetinib demonstrate profound, durable antitumor activity in advanced RET-mutant medullary and RET-fusion thyroid carcinomas in LIBRETTO-001. Selpercatinib achieved an objective response rate of seventy percent in pretreated MTC, producing durable remissions with low rates of off-target toxicities.

nodes.label: Genomic profiling (RET mutation or RET fusion)

steps.tx: **Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma** ATC is an undifferentiated, highly lethal malignancy; BRAF V600E-mutant ATC responds rapidly to combination dabrafenib and trametinib targeted therapy. In the ROAR phase 2 basket trial, dabrafenib plus trametinib achieved a confirmed objective response rate of sixty-nine percent, converting fulminant inoperable tracheal invasion into resectable disease and extending one-year overall survival to eighty percent.

steps.tx: Biochemical monitoring tracks curative success and heralds occult tumour relapse. Serum **thyroglobulin** Tg measured under TSH stimulation is the primary surveillance biomarker for identifying persistent or recurrent disease after thyroidectomy and radioiodine remnant ablation. Concurrently measuring antithyroglobulin antibodies is mandatory to prevent false-negative thyroglobulin immunoassay results caused by circulating autoantibody interference.

left.title: Stimulated Thyroglobulin Surveillance
points: Stimulated via rhTSH or LT4 withdrawal (TSH > 30)
Stimulated Tg < 1 ng/mL indicates excellent response
Rising Tg triggers neck ultrasound and PET-CT

right.title: Anti-Thyroglobulin Antibodies (anti-Tg)
points: Present in 20% to 25% of thyroid cancer patients
Rising anti-Tg serves as surrogate marker of recurrence
